notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands, seven of which enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {7}.
description:
Activate seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {7}.
Activate Meloku seven times by paying {7} and returning the seven lands from the battlefield to your hand, creating seven 1/1 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Illusions, adding {4}{G}{G}.
Cast Journey to the Oracle by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Unifying Theory triggers, causing you to pay {2} to draw a card.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting at least seven lands from your hand onto the battlefield, then causing you to discard a card and Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
